item.title: Team Peterson Qualifies for 2026 Winter Olympic Games for Women’s Curling
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.-Duluth Native Cory Thiesse and Team Peterson have qualified for the Winter Olympics and will represent Team USA. Team Peterson defeated Norway 8-4 at the Olympic Qualification event earlier this week. Team USA will begin the Winter Olympic games in Italy on Thursday, February 12th. Categories: Professional Sports, Sports
